Use case: ui-mockup.
Task: revise the supplied pixel-art lighthouse defense preparation UI for the Russian game "Свет Авалона" according to precise user feedback. Keep its polished blue-slate chipped-stone panels, warm pale Cyrillic lettering, fine pixel clusters and warm lighthouse windows. This is a full-bleed game UI mockup, no phone frame or artboard. Pixel art, no blurry photorealism, no shiny generic mobile-game crystals, no huge menu boulders.
Important map contract: the preparation map and combat map are ONE AND THE SAME WORLD, same terrain and same sprite instances at fixed world positions. Beginning combat will only zoom the camera OUT, no replacement island, no moving or rotating the lighthouse, shore, cannons or barrier. The preparation scene must look like a playable TOP-DOWN GENERAL VIEW, with mild oblique depth at most, NOT a cinematic close-up or side view with a giant lighthouse. Existing game world: a straight vertical shoreline through the center, LAND on LEFT and SEA on RIGHT, compact lighthouse on the boundary, sea remains playable. Preserve the shore geography and the relative object positions from the reference as closely as possible: lighthouse center at shore, one cannon above-left and another below-left, low barrier left of lighthouse between the cannon rows. Cannons' barrels face OUTWARD toward land approach directions, away from lighthouse, not toward their own lighthouse. Keep their silhouettes readable. Barrier is on an approach to lighthouse without overlapping its base, no fake path funnel. Ruins are peripheral decoration, no build sockets, no grid, no enemies frozen on the map, no invented fixed spawn arrows. Subtle dotted placement extent on land, damaged lower cannon HP bar.
Currency style correction: replace the generic orange crystal cluster by ONE angular silver-grey ANCIENT RUNIC STONE SHARD with a faint warm-gold engraved rune and a worn bronze edge, clearly a shard, restrained Arthurian/Celtic relic visual language. No new currency name and no specific lore. Replace the bright candy jewel in open shell by a ROUND MILKY IVORY PEARL with a cold pale-teal reflection held by a small aged-bronze CELTIC KNOT MOUNT, subtle and recognizably pearl, no shell, no crown, no new currency. Counters still exactly 136 and 3. EACH counter has its OWN clearly visible small stone "+" BUTTON directly at the right of its number, visually separated by a short divider; there are exactly two plus buttons for voluntary rewarded-ad top-ups. Not a dollar shop, no price, no ad quantity promised.
Rename the skill-tree button EXACTLY "УЛУЧШЕНИЯ", with a small branching-node skill-tree diagram icon; NEVER write "ДЕРЕВО" and never use logs or botanical tree. Keep "РАЗВЕДКА" with spyglass. Name of chapter/night stays "ГЛАВА I · ТУМАННЫЙ БЕРЕГ" / "НОЧЬ 2 · РАЗБИТЫЙ БЕРЕГ" with dropdown chevron. Main state is "ПОДГОТОВКА · 4 ВОЛНЫ".
ONLY ONE map viewport on the screen at any time. NO minimap, NO split screen, NO simultaneous overview/close-up, NO second scene in a panel. A legible map toolbar button exact "КРУПНЫЙ ПЛАН" with magnifying icon toggles the one viewport into zoomed view only after tapping it. Current illustrated state is the general overhead view.
Device catalogue correction: replace the permanent individual "ПУШКА", "БАРЬЕР", "ЗАПАС" three-button arrangement with ONE clear primary catalogue control "УСТРОЙСТВА" with a small grouped mechanical-device/armory sprite and subtitle "ВЫБРАТЬ И РАССТАВИТЬ". It opens a scrollable catalogue of many device types; do not imply only cannon and barrier exist. The main UI is compact, full catalogue is closed. Keep separate equipment tiles "ЛИНЗА / БАЗОВАЯ" and "СПОСОБНОСТЬ / ВСПЫШКА", separate counts "Объекты 3/4 · Типы 2/2", and prominent warm-bevel button "НАЧАТЬ НОЧЬ". Quiet footer "Расстановка и старт бесплатны".
Use only these labels, exact readable Cyrillic, generous touch sizes, no new mechanics or ad rewards, no watermark.
Input image is the WIDE DESKTOP edit target. Output ONE wide 16:9 full-bleed desktop screenshot, same proportions around 1672x941. Top toolbar: "НАЗАД", chapter/night, the two new styled currency counters with one plus each, "УЛУЧШЕНИЯ" and "РАЗВЕДКА". Fit all with calm readable spacing; adjust block widths for the longer improvements label, do not clip text or overlap counters. One large field underneath takes most of the screen with high overhead camera; lighthouse should be substantially compact relative to field. Place the single "КРУПНЫЙ ПЛАН" map button unobtrusively at top-right of the field, with enough room for the small "ПОДГОТОВКА · 4 ВОЛНЫ" label at top-left. Bottom external slim dock: "УСТРОЙСТВА / ВЫБРАТЬ И РАССТАВИТЬ" catalogue control on left, lens and ability tiles centrally, counts line and "НАЧАТЬ НОЧЬ" on right. No side panel over sea, no open catalogue in this state. Preserve the exact reference terrain layout and three placed object positions; camera distance may change, geometry must not.
